change.description: Precompute immutable CUDA RoPE sine/cosine tables for512 positions per attention type; use exact prefix views for short sequences instead of per-input host construction and upload. No output/result cache, arithmetic batching, precision or model changes.
change.eligibility: CUDA only; both attention head dimensions positive, <=512 and divisible by8; both theta parameters finite and positive. Missing/incompatible parameters preserve original lazy behavior.
change.why_multiple_of_eight: Original CPU sine/cosine construction uses vectorized blocks of8 followed by a scalar tail. Prefixing a larger table must not replace a scalar-tail computation with differently rounded vector operations.
change.constant_storage: At most4 MiB per eligible model,3 MiB for the pinned canonical checkpoint. CPU/Metal and sequences>512 use original construction. Readout bound remains8.

protocol: Immutable-current-baseline ABBA, three warmups per case, five >=200ms samples per process/case, two complete repeats, identical assets/flags. All repeated output bits and token IDs checked. Sum of per-case median warm latencies; host vectors complete before timing ends.

discarded.reason: gain comparable with variation; retain tested8-row bound

combined_repeats.load_note: OS/compiler caches not cleared; loading is monitored separately, not claimed as a causal startup improvement.

direct_vs_original_serial_build.note: Measured directly, not multiplied historical speedups.
